title: AI providers & models
description: Choose which provider and model handles which task. Changes apply immediately – no deployment needed.
envFallbackHint: No provider yet – the OPENROUTER_API_KEY from the environment is used with default models.
providersDescription: Any OpenAI-compatible provider: OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM, OpenAI, Groq, Mistral, Ollama … API keys are stored encrypted.
baseUrlHint: Up to and including /v1, e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted and never shown in the browser.
apiKeyKeep: Stored: {masked}. Leave empty to keep it.
extraHeadersHint: One header per line as “Name: value”.
deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? {n} tasks will fall back to the default configuration.
keyBroken: Key cannot be decrypted (APP_SECRET changed?) – please re-enter.
routingDescription: Pick provider, model and fallback per task. Use different model families for translation and translation review – that gives an independent second opinion.
testSkippedImage: Image models are not tested live to save cost – see capabilities in the model list.
modelNotListed: Not in the provider's model list
noErrors: No errors in the last 30 days.
